messages.subject: Behaviour of hdfs.put
parts:
I have a one column file of numbers in CentOS local file system as:

30
31
32
33

When I use the hdfs.put() command to copy this file to hadoop FS, the numbers
in the file get enclosed by double inverted commas, as:

"30"
"31"
"32"
"33"

Is there a way to avoid the double inverted commas while copying?
(My command is: 
 hdfs.put(src="test.txt",dest="/user/test/test.txt")
)

Thanks.
